correctness.rationale: Substituting the singular boundary equality into the source return map gives \(R(A)=0\). The sign hypotheses make both explicit flight times positive, so the fixed point is a physical grazing cycle rather than an algebraic zero-time artifact. Writing \(x=A+s u\) on the returning side gives exactly \(u^+=\sqrt{u(u+2\rho)}\). The recurrence is strictly increasing and divergent, its increment tends to \(\rho\), and after normalization the expansion \(v_{n+1}-v_n=1-1/(2v_n)+O(v_n^{-2})\), together with \(v_n/n\to1\), gives a summable correction to \(v_n-n+\tfrac12\log n\); hence the stated finite constant and logarithmic escape law. The derivation is analytic and does not rely on a finite trajectory experiment.
